title: The Angelus (Regina Caeli in Eastertide)
description: Three daily pauses recalling the Incarnation — 6am, noon, 6pm · ~3 min

steps.versicle: The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
steps.response: And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.

steps.versicle: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.
steps.response: Be it done unto me according to Thy word.

steps.versicle: And the Word was made flesh.

angelus_collect.text:
V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Let us pray. Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, Thy Son, was made known by the message of an angel, may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

regina_caeli_collect.text: O God, who by the Resurrection of Thine only-begotten Son, and by the co-operation of the Holy Ghost, hast given unto the world the joy of everlasting life; grant, we beseech Thee, that through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary, His Mother, we may attain unto the joys of everlasting life. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

regina_caeli_versicles.text:
V. Queen of Heaven, rejoice, alleluia.
R. For He whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia.
V. Has risen as He said, alleluia.
R. Pray for us to God, alleluia.
V. Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia.
R. For the Lord hath truly risen, alleluia.
